messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still facing away, then briefly turns his head and raises his arms to adjust his jacket before returning to a stationary stance.","camera":"A static, medium shot from behind the character at roughly eye level.","clothing":"A dark, long-sleeved jacket with several torn holes revealing skin on the back and shoulders, paired with dark trousers.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a stocky build, seen from behind.","scene":"A futuristic, open-air plaza with a wet, reflective floor, glowing red and cyan light strips, and tall modern buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static medium/upper-body shot from behind the character, matching the reference framing at the start. The character remains in a futuristic plaza and performs a brief head turn and jacket adjustment, then returns to standing still.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to an upper-body shot from behind, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, scene, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression was preserved, since the face is mostly not visible from behind.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears white and spiky instead of the source's white cap/hat.
The jacket now has large torn holes on the back and shoulders, unlike the intact dark uniform in the source.
The source's rotating camera movement and full-body framing were replaced by a static upper-body rear shot.
The character's action was reduced to a brief head turn and jacket adjustment rather than the source's continuous turning/walking progression.
